_comment: Six synthetic demo questions in the same schema as the study question sets (medqa_derma_final.json / pubmed_vignettes_medqa.json). Every answer is stated in demo/corpus/, so the demo exercises retrieval end-to-end without the licensed corpora. These are NOT study questions and carry no clinical authority.

0.question: A 19-year-old man has comedones together with inflammatory papules and pustules on the face, without nodules or scarring. Which of the following is the recommended first-line topical treatment?

answer_options.A: Fixed-dose combination of adapalene and benzoyl peroxide once daily

0.correct_answer: Fixed-dose combination of adapalene and benzoyl peroxide once daily

1.question: A 45-year-old woman has plaque psoriasis affecting 18% of her body surface area. She has no contraindications to systemic therapy and has not been treated systemically before. Which first-line conventional systemic agent is recommended?

answer_options.C: Methotrexate once weekly with folic acid

1.correct_answer: Methotrexate once weekly with folic acid

2.question: A 32-year-old woman has had recurrent pruritic weals for four months, each individual lesion resolving within a day and leaving no mark. No external trigger is identifiable. What is the recommended first-line pharmacotherapy?

answer_options.B: A second-generation H1 antihistamine at the standard licensed dose

2.correct_answer: A second-generation H1 antihistamine at the standard licensed dose

3.question: A 7-year-old boy has an expanding scaly patch of hair loss on the scalp with broken hairs, and culture grows a Trichophyton species. Which treatment approach is required?

answer_options.A: Topical terbinafine cream alone for two weeks
answer_options.D: Oral terbinafine, with antifungal shampoo only as an adjunct

3.correct_answer: Oral terbinafine, with antifungal shampoo only as an adjunct

4.question: A patient reports itchy skin lesions. Which feature argues against urticaria and should prompt a lesional biopsy?

answer_options.A: Individual lesions persisting beyond 24 hours and resolving with pigmentation
answer_options.B: Weals that migrate over the trunk within hours
answer_options.D: Symptoms lasting longer than six weeks

4.correct_answer: Individual lesions persisting beyond 24 hours and resolving with pigmentation

5.question: An adult with severe nodular acne and early scarring has not responded to 12 weeks of an appropriate topical regimen. Which systemic option is indicated, and what precaution is mandatory?

answer_options.A: Topical clindamycin monotherapy, no precaution needed
answer_options.B: Doxycycline indefinitely, with annual liver enzymes
answer_options.C: Isotretinoin, with mandatory pregnancy prevention for patients who can become pregnant

5.correct_answer: Isotretinoin, with mandatory pregnancy prevention for patients who can become pregnant
